qe: Which of the following political associations was established in 1836 by the close associates of Raja Rammohan Roy, marking an early step in organized socio-political expression in Bengal?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा राजनीतिक संघ 1836 में राजा राममोहन राय के करीबी सहयोगियों द्वारा स्थापित किया गया था, जो बंगाल में संगठित सामाजिक-राजनीतिक अभिव्यक्ति का एक प्रारंभिक चरण था?
o: Bangabhasha Prakasika Sabha
Landholders' Society
Bengal British India Society
British Indian Association
e: Detailed Explanation: The Bangabhasha Prakasika Sabha was formed in the year 1836 by the associates of Raja Rammohan Roy. It was one of the earliest associations in Bengal formed to discuss government policies and represent public grievances.

qe: The Zamindari Association, which was founded in Bengal to safeguard the class interests of the landlords, is historically more popular under which name?
qh: जमींदारी एसोसिएशन, जिसकी स्थापना बंगाल में जमींदारों के वर्गीय हितों की रक्षा के लिए की गई थी, ऐतिहासिक रूप से किस नाम से अधिक लोकप्रिय है?
o: Landholders' Society
Bengal British India Society
British Indian Association
Indian League
e: Detailed Explanation: The Zamindari Association was popularly known as the 'Landholders’ Society'. Though limited in its objective of protecting the interests of landlords, it marked the formal beginning of organized political activity and constitutional agitation methods in India.

qe: What was the primary stated objective behind the establishment of the Bengal British India Society in 1843?
qh: 1843 में 'बंगाल ब्रिटिश इंडिया सोसाइटी' की स्थापना के पीछे घोषित प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: The collection and dissemination of information relating to the actual condition of the people of British India
To launch an immediate armed rebellion against the local zamindari land systems
To exclusively safeguard and legally defend the financial revenue models of the wealthy landlords
To directly manage the competitive civil services examination tracking metrics in London
e: Detailed Explanation: The Bengal British India Society was founded in 1843. Its primary objective was the collection and dissemination of accurate information regarding the actual socioeconomic condition of the people of British India to secure their welfare and extend their rights through peaceful means.

qe: In 1851, the Landholders' Society and the Bengal British India Society merged to form a unified organization. What was the name of this newly created body?
qh: 1851 में, लैंडहोल्डर्स सोसाइटी और बंगाल ब्रिटिश इंडिया सोसाइटी का आपस में विलय हो गया। इस नवगठित संस्था का नाम क्या था?
o: British Indian Association
Indian League
Indian Association of Calcutta
East India Association
e: Detailed Explanation: In 1851, both the Landholders' Society and the Bengal British India Society merged to form the British Indian Association, creating a more consolidated platform to petition the colonial government.

qe: The British Indian Association sent a petition to the British Parliament regarding the Charter renewal. Which of their constitutional demands was partially conceded by the Charter Act of 1853?
qh: ब्रिटिश इंडियन एसोसिएशन ने चार्टर नवीनीकरण के संबंध में ब्रिटिश संसद को एक याचिका भेजी थी। उनकी कौन सी संवैधानिक मांग 1853 के चार्टर अधिनियम द्वारा आंशिक रूप से स्वीकार की गई थी?
o: The addition of six members to the Governor-General’s council for legislative purposes
The absolute and complete separation of the executive from judicial functions in districts
The immediate universal abolition of all salt, stamp, and abkari excise duties
The total Indianization of all superior administrative civil service positions
e: Detailed Explanation: The British Indian Association petitioned for a separate legislature of a popular character. This was partially accepted when the Charter Act of 1853 provided for the addition of six new members to the Governor-General’s council specifically for legislative purposes.

qe: Dadabhai Naoroji organized the East India Association in 1866 to discuss the Indian question and influence public opinion abroad. In which city was this association founded?
qh: दादाभाई नौरोजी ने भारतीय प्रश्न पर चर्चा करने और विदेशों में जनमत को प्रभावित करने के लिए 1866 में ईस्ट इंडिया एसोसिएशन का गठन किया था। इस एसोसिएशन की स्थापना किस शहर में हुई थी?
o: London
Calcutta
Bombay
Madras
e: Detailed Explanation: Dadabhai Naoroji founded the East India Association in 1866 in London. Its purpose was to clarify Indian grievances and influence British public men and Parliament to promote Indian welfare. Branches were later opened in major Indian cities.

qe: The 'Indian League' was established in 1875 with the primary object of stimulating a sense of nationalism and encouraging political education. Who was its founder?
qh: 1875 में 'इंडियन लीग' की स्थापना राष्ट्रवाद की भावना को जगाने और राजनीतिक शिक्षा को प्रोत्साहित करने के प्राथमिक उद्देश्य से की गई थी। इसके संस्थापक कौन थे?
o: Sisir Kumar Ghosh
Surendranath Banerjea
Ananda Mohan Bose
W.C. Bonnerjee
e: Detailed Explanation: The Indian League was started in 1875 by Sisir Kumar Ghosh in Calcutta, with the explicit progressive goal of cultivating nationalist consciousness and political awareness among the masses.

qe: The Indian Association of Calcutta (or Indian National Association) was founded in 1876 by younger nationalists who were discontented with the pro-landlord policies of older groups. Who were its main architects?
qh: कलकत्ता की इंडियन एसोसिएशन (या इंडियन नेशनल एसोसिएशन) की स्थापना 1876 में उन युवा राष्ट्रवादियों द्वारा की गई थी जो पुराने समूहों की जमींदार-समर्थक नीतियों से असंतुष्ट थे। इसके मुख्य वास्तुकार कौन थे?
o: Surendranath Banerjea and Ananda Mohan Bose
Dadabhai Naoroji and Dinshaw Wacha
Badruddin Tyabji and Pherozshah Mehta
M. Viraraghavachariar and P. Anandacharlu
e: Detailed Explanation: The Indian Association of Calcutta was founded in 1876 by younger nationalists led by Surendranath Banerjea and Ananda Mohan Bose, breaking away from the conservative, landlord-dominated British Indian Association.

qe: The Indian Association of Calcutta actively launched a major national campaign in 1877 to protest against which regressive administrative step taken by the colonial government?
qh: इंडियन एसोसिएशन ऑफ कलकत्ता ने 1877 में औपनिवेशिक सरकार द्वारा उठाए गए किस प्रतिगामी प्रशासनिक कदम का विरोध करने के लिए एक बड़ा राष्ट्रीय अभियान शुरू किया था?
o: The reduction of the maximum age limit for candidates of the Indian Civil Service examination
The complete legal separation of the judicial benches from provincial executive oversight
The levying of an automatic internal excise transit duty on all native cotton mills
The mandatory use of English instead of Persian across all local lower subdivisions
e: Detailed Explanation: In 1877, the colonial government lowered the maximum age limit for the Indian Civil Service (ICS) examination from 21 to 19 years to discourage Indians. The Indian Association led an intensive pan-India protest campaign against this discriminatory measure.

qe: To broadbase its membership and attract the poorer and working sections of society, how did the Indian Association of Calcutta structure its institutional framework?
qh: अपनी सदस्यता को व्यापक बनाने और समाज के गरीब तथा श्रमिक वर्गों को आकर्षित करने के लिए, इंडियन एसोसिएशन ऑफ कलकत्ता ने अपने संस्थागत ढांचे को कैसे व्यवस्थित किया?
o: It kept its official membership fee low and opened branches in remote towns
It restricted its leadership positions exclusively to the wealthy regional zamindars
It required all members to hold highly technical engineering degrees from London
It operated as a completely secret society that avoided any public political propaganda
e: Detailed Explanation: Unlike earlier aristocratic organizations, the Indian Association of Calcutta aimed to involve wider sections of society. To achieve this, it kept its membership fees low and opened rural branches across Bengal and other provinces.

qe: The Indian Association of Calcutta sponsored a landmark historic All India Conference in Calcutta from December 28 to 30, 1883. Why is this conference considered a critical forerunner of the Indian National Congress?
qh: इंडियन एसोसिएशन ऑफ कलकत्ता ने 28 से 30 दिसंबर, 1883 तक कलकत्ता में एक ऐतिहासिक अखिल भारतीय सम्मेलन (All India Conference) को प्रायोजित किया। इस सम्मेलन को भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का एक महत्वपूर्ण अग्रदूत क्यों माना जाता है?
o: It was the first major national gathering that brought together more than a hundred political delegates from different parts of India
It drafted the legal civil code metrics that completely replaced all traditional shastras
It formally introduced a resolution demanding the immediate armed partition of the country
It was funded entirely by the British Chamber of Commerce to manage corporate tax collections
e: Detailed Explanation: The National Conference organized in Calcutta in December 1883 attracted more than a hundred political delegates from various parts of India, creating the first multi-regional nationalist platform and serving as an operational blueprint for the Indian National Congress.

qe: The Poona Sarvajanik Sabha was founded in 1867 with the progressive objective of serving as an active communication bridge between the government and the people. Who was its chief mentor?
qh: पूना सार्वजनिक सभा की स्थापना 1867 में सरकार और जनता के बीच एक सक्रिय संचार सेतु के रूप में कार्य करने के प्रगतिशील उद्देश्य से की गई थी। इसके मुख्य संरक्षक कौन थे?
o: Mahadeo Govind Ranade
Badruddin Tyabji
Pherozshah Mehta
Gopal Krishna Gokhale
e: Detailed Explanation: The Poona Sarvajanik Sabha was established in 1867 by Mahadeo Govind Ranade and his close associates in Maharashtra to represent the popular political aspirations of the public before the colonial state.

qe: Which triad of distinguished independent nationalist intellectuals founded the Bombay Presidency Association in 1885?
qh: प्रतिष्ठित स्वतंत्र राष्ट्रवादी बुद्धिजीवियों के किस त्रिमूर्ति ने 1885 में बॉम्बे प्रेसीडेंसी एसोसिएशन (Bombay Presidency Association) की स्थापना की थी?
o: Badruddin Tyabji, Pherozshah Mehta, and K.T. Telang
Surendranath Banerjea, Ananda Mohan Bose, and Sisir Kumar Ghosh
M. Viraraghavachari, B. Subramaniya Aiyer, and P. Anandacharlu
Dadabhai Naoroji, Dinshaw Wacha, and G.K. Gokhale
e: Detailed Explanation: The Bombay Presidency Association was established in 1885 by the famous political triad of Badruddin Tyabji, Pherozshah Mehta, and K.T. Telang (popularly known as the 'Triumvirate of Bombay's public life').

qe: In the Madras Presidency, which prominent group of leaders established the Madras Mahajan Sabha in 1884 to coordinate localized political activities?
qh: मद्रास प्रेसीडेंसी में, स्थानीय राजनीतिक गतिविधियों के समन्वय के लिए 1884 में किस प्रमुख समूह ने 'मद्रास महाजन सभा' की स्थापना की थी?
o: M. Viraraghavachari, B. Subramaniya Aiyar, and P. Anandacharlu
Mahadeo Govind Ranade, R.G. Bhandarkar, and N.G. Chandavarkar
Sisir Kumar Ghosh, Motilal Ghosh, and N.N. Sen
W.C. Bonnerjee, A.O. Hume, and Lord Dufferin
e: Detailed Explanation: The Madras Mahajan Sabha was established in May 1884 by M. Viraraghavachari, B. Subramaniya Aiyer, and P. Anandacharlu to unify provincial public opinion on administrative reforms.

qe: A retired English civil servant mobilized leading intellectuals to organize the very first historic session of the Indian National Congress in December 1885. What was his name?
qh: एक सेवानिवृत्त अंग्रेज सिविल सेवक ने दिसंबर 1885 में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के पहले ऐतिहासिक सत्र को आयोजित करने के लिए प्रमुख बुद्धिजीवियों को लामबंद किया। उनका नाम क्या था?
o: Allan Octavian Hume
William Wedderburn
Henry Cotton
Lord Dufferin
e: Detailed Explanation: Allan Octavian Hume (A.O. Hume), a retired British civil servant, played a catalytic role by mobilizing leading Indian intellectuals from various presidencies to establish the Indian National Congress.

qe: At which specific location in Bombay did the Indian National Congress hold its inaugural national session from December 28 to 31, 1885?
qh: बॉम्बे में किस विशिष्ट स्थान पर भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस ने 28 से 31 दिसंबर, 1885 तक अपना उद्घाटन राष्ट्रीय सत्र आयोजित किया था?
o: Gokuldas Tejpal Sanskrit College
Ferguson College grounds
Sanskrit College of Calcutta premises
Elphinstone Institutional Assembly Hall
e: Detailed Explanation: The first session of the Indian National Congress was held at Gokuldas Tejpal Sanskrit College in Bombay in late December 1885. It was originally scheduled for Poona but shifted due to a cholera outbreak.

qe: How many political delegates from across different towns of India attended the first historic session of the Indian National Congress in 1885?
qh: 1885 में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के पहले ऐतिहासिक सत्र में भारत के विभिन्न शहरों से कितने राजनीतिक प्रतिनिधियों ने भाग लिया था?
o: 72 delegates
100 delegates
35 delegates
24 delegates
e: Detailed Explanation: The first national session of the Indian National Congress in Bombay was attended by exactly 72 political delegates representing the newly educated professional classes from all major presidencies and towns of India.

qe: Who holds the distinction of being elected as the very first President of the Indian National Congress during its historic 1885 Bombay session?
qh: 1885 के ऐतिहासिक बॉम्बे सत्र के दौरान भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के पहले अध्यक्ष के रूप में चुने जाने का गौरव किसे प्राप्त है?
o: Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee
Dadabhai Naoroji
Badruddin Tyabji
Pherozshah Mehta
e: Detailed Explanation: Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee (W.C. Bonnerjee), a leading barrister from Bengal, was elected as the first President of the Indian National Congress at its inaugural session in 1885.

qe: Who addressed the 1890 Congress session as the first woman graduate of Calcutta University, symbolizing the commitment of the national struggle to uplift women's status?
qh: कलकत्ता विश्वविद्यालय की पहली महिला स्नातक के रूप में किसने 1890 के कांग्रेस सत्र को संबोधित किया, जो महिलाओं की स्थिति के उत्थान के लिए राष्ट्रीय संघर्ष की प्रतिबद्धता का प्रतीक था?
o: Kadambini Ganguly
Sarojini Naidu
Sarla Devi Chaudhurani
Pandita Ramabai
e: Detailed Explanation: In 1890, Kadambini Ganguly, the first female medical graduate of Calcutta University, addressed the Congress session. Her address symbolised the core commitment of the national freedom struggle to elevate women's status in public life.

qe: The 'Safety Valve' theory regarding the origin of the Indian National Congress asserts that the organization was created to abort popular uprisings. Which Marxist historian prominently put forward this 'conspiracy theory' in his work?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस की उत्पत्ति के संबंध में 'सेफ्टी वाल्व' (Safety Valve) सिद्धांत यह दावा करता है कि संगठन का निर्माण लोकप्रिय विद्रोहों को विफल करने के लिए किया गया था। किस मार्क्सवादी इतिहासकार ने अपनी कृति में इस 'साजिश सिद्धांत' (conspiracy theory) को प्रमुखता से पेश किया?
o: R.P. Dutt
Bipan Chandra
Lala Lajpat Rai
Dadabhai Naoroji
e: Detailed Explanation: The Marxist historian R.P. Dutt, in his structural economic and political analyses, opined that the Indian National Congress was born out of a secret conspiracy between colonial authorities and bourgeois leaders to prevent a popular violent uprising in India.

qe: Modern Indian historians like Bipan Chandra dispute the 'Safety Valve' theory. What alternative conceptual term do they use to explain why early Congress leaders cooperated with A.O. Hume?
qh: बिपिन चंद्र जैसे आधुनिक भारतीय इतिहासकार 'सेफ्टी वाल्व' सिद्धांत का खंडन करते हैं। शुरुआती कांग्रेस नेताओं ने ए.ओ. ह्यूम के साथ क्यों सहयोग किया, इसे समझाने के लिए वे किस वैकल्पिक वैचारिक शब्द का उपयोग करते हैं?
o: Lightning Conductor
Allosteric Catalyst
Sub-infeudation Buffer
Sedimentary Matrix
e: Detailed Explanation: Bipan Chandra noted that early Congress leaders used A.O. Hume as a 'lightning conductor'—a dynamic catalyst to safely gather and organize nationalist political forces under a single body without inviting immediate, crushing suppression from the colonial bureaucracy.

qe: The early phase of the Indian National Congress between 1885 and 1905 was dominated by leaders who relied on constitutional agitation. What historical label is assigned to this group?
qh: 1885 और 1905 के बीच भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के प्रारंभिक चरण में उन नेताओं का वर्चस्व था जो संवैधानिक आंदोलन पर निर्भर थे। इस समूह को कौन सा ऐतिहासिक लेबल दिया गया है?
o: The Moderates
The Extremists
The Derozians
The Wahabis
e: Detailed Explanation: The early Congress leaders (like Dadabhai Naoroji, Pherozshah Mehta, and S.N. Banerjea) who operated within the confines of colonial law using prayers, petitions, and resolutions are historically categorized as the Moderates.

qe: What baseline methodology did the Moderate nationalists utilize to convince the British authorities to introduce administrative and legislative reforms in India?
qh: नरमपंथी (Moderate) राष्ट्रवादियों ने ब्रिटिश अधिकारियों को भारत में प्रशासनिक और विधायी सुधार शुरू करने के लिए मनाने के लिए किस बुनियादी कार्यप्रणाली का उपयोग किया?
o: Creating public opinion in India and presenting demands through resolutions, petitions, and constitutional agitation
Launching immediate armed parameter rebellions and labor factory strikes
The total structural boycott of all vernacular educational institutions
Organizing secret societies that executed localized violent attacks against district collectors
e: Detailed Explanation: The Moderates believed that the British values were just but that authorities were unaware of real conditions. Their two-pronged methodology involved creating public opinion to educate the masses on political questions, and presenting systematic petitions and resolutions to persuade the British public and government to grant reforms.

qe: To project the nationalist views and campaign for India's administrative case directly within Great Britain, a British Committee of the Indian National Congress was established in London in 1889. What was the name of its official organ journal?
qh: सीधे ग्रेट ब्रिटेन के भीतर भारत के प्रशासनिक मामले के लिए अभियान चलाने के लिए 1889 में लंदन में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस की एक ब्रिटिश समिति की स्थापना की गई थी। इसके आधिकारिक अंग पत्रिका (organ journal) का नाम क्या था?
o: India
Darpan
Satya Prakash
Rast Goftar
e: Detailed Explanation: The British Committee of the Indian National Congress was set up in London in 1889. It began publishing a specialized weekly journal named 'India' to educate British public men and politicians about actual conditions in the sub-continent.

qe: The early Moderate nationalists carefully dissected the political economy of British imperialism and put forward the 'Drain Theory'. Who were the primary authors of this economic critique?
qh: शुरुआती नरमपंथी राष्ट्रवादियों ने ब्रिटिश साम्राज्यवाद की राजनीतिक अर्थव्यवस्था का सावधानीपूर्वक विश्लेषण किया और 'ड्रेन थ्योरी' (Drain Theory) को पेश किया। इस आर्थिक आलोचना के प्राथमिक लेखक कौन थे?
o: Dadabhai Naoroji, R.C. Dutt, and Dinshaw Wacha
Surendranath Banerjea, Ananda Mohan Bose, and Sisir Kumar Ghosh
W.C. Bonnerjee, A.O. Hume, and Lord Dufferin
Badruddin Tyabji, Pherozshah Mehta, and K.T. Telang
e: Detailed Explanation: The economic critique of British imperialism was a major contribution of the Moderates. Led by Dadabhai Naoroji, Romesh Chandra Dutt (R.C. Dutt), and Dinshaw Wacha, they formulated the drain theory to show how colonial forces impoverished India.

qe: Which of the following fiscal demands was continuously raised by the Moderate nationalists in their annual resolutions to reduce the deprivation characterizing Indian rural life?
qh: भारतीय ग्रामीण जीवन की अभावग्रस्तता को कम करने के लिए नरमपंथी राष्ट्रवादियों द्वारा अपने वार्षिक प्रस्तावों में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी वित्तीय मांग लगातार उठाई गई थी?
o: Reduction in land revenue, abolition of the salt tax, and direct government aid to modern industries
The absolute expansion of private land sales and total privatization of forests
The complete removal of all technical engineering subjects from local colleges
Levying a high transit duty on consumer goods consumed by the poorest sections
e: Detailed Explanation: To ease the economic burden on the masses, the Moderates demanded a substantial reduction in land revenue, the complete abolition of the regressive salt tax, a cut in heavy military expenditures, and tariff protections for modern native industries.

qe: How many total Indian members were nominated to the Imperial Legislative Council in the thirty-year span between 1862 and 1892, reflecting its unrepresentative structural layout?
qh: 1862 और 1892 के बीच तीस साल की अवधि में इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल में कुल कितने भारतीय सदस्यों को नामांकित किया गया था, जो इसके अप्रतिनिधिक संरचनात्मक लेआउट को दर्शाता है?
o: 45 Indians
72 Indians
100 Indians
15 Indians
e: Detailed Explanation: The Imperial Legislative Council under the Act of 1861 was an unrepresentative body. In the thirty years from 1862 to 1892, only forty-five Indians were nominated to it, most of whom were wealthy landlords or loyalist princes.

qe: Despite the conservative composition of the Imperial Legislative Council before 1892, which handful of independent intellectuals and political figures managed to get nominated and criticize official measures?
qh: 1892 से पहले इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल की रूढ़िवादी संरचना के बावजूद, कौन से स्वतंत्र बुद्धिजीवी और राजनीतिक व्यक्ति नामांकित होने और आधिकारिक उपायों की आलोचना करने में सफल रहे?
o: Syed Ahmed Khan, Kristodas Pal, V.N. Mandlik, K.L. Nulkar, and Rashbehari Ghosh
Surendranath Banerjea, Ananda Mohan Bose, Sisir Kumar Ghosh, and Motilal Ghosh
M. Viraraghavachari, B. Subramaniya Aiyer, P. Anandacharlu, and G.P. Verma
Lala Lajpat Rai, Lala Hansraj, Lala Lal Chand, and Swami Shraddhanand
e: Detailed Explanation: While the majority of nominees were loyalist elites, a few independent intellectuals—such as Sir Syed Ahmed Khan, Kristodas Pal, V.N. Mandlik, K.L. Nulkar, and Rashbehari Ghosh—were nominated and raised critical voices.

qe: From 1885 to 1892, the constitutional demands of the early Moderate nationalists were primarily centered on which two structural areas?
qh: 1885 से 1892 तक, शुरुआती नरमपंथी राष्ट्रवादियों की संवैधानिक मांगें मुख्य रूप से किन दो संरचनात्मक क्षेत्रों पर केंद्रित थीं?
o: Expansion of legislative councils to increase Indian participation, and reform of councils to secure greater control over public finances
The immediate military partition of the country into separate religious provincial segments
The absolute legal transfer of all high court judicial powers to traditional village panchayats
The complete closing of all government-controlled universities and Khalsa schools
e: Detailed Explanation: During its first seven years, the Congress focused on constitutional reforms centered on: 1. the expansion of legislative councils (increasing the number of Indian members), and 2. the reform of councils (giving them real powers, especially control over public finances).

qe: What famous democratic political slogan did the early nationalists popularize when demanding greater structural control over the state budget inside the legislative councils?
qh: विधान परिषदों के भीतर राज्य के बजट पर अधिक संरचनात्मक नियंत्रण की मांग करते समय शुरुआती राष्ट्रवादियों ने कौन सा प्रसिद्ध लोकतांत्रिक राजनीतिक नारा लोकप्रिय बनाया था?
o: No taxation without representation
Back to the Vedas
One religion, one caste, one God for mankind
Educate, Agitate and Organise
e: Detailed Explanation: Discontented with the minor concessions of the 1892 reforms, the nationalists demanded a majority of elected Indian representatives and the power to vote on the budget, popularizing the famous democratic slogan: 'No taxation without representation'.

qe: In the early 1900s, Moderate leaders like Dadabhai Naoroji (1904), Gopal Krishna Gokhale (1905), and Lokmanya Tilak (1906) expanded their constitutional goals to demand self-government on the lines of which specific British colonies?
qh: 1900 के दशक की शुरुआत में, दादाभाई नौरोजी (1904), गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले (1905), और लोकमान्य तिलक (1906) जैसे नरमपंथी नेताओं ने अपनी संवैधानिक मांगों का विस्तार करते हुए किन विशिष्ट ब्रिटिश उपनिवेशों की तर्ज पर स्वशासन (self-government) की मांग की थी?
o: Canada and Australia
Ireland and South Africa
Burma and Ceylon
The American Presidencies
e: Detailed Explanation: As the national movement matured, the scope of demands widened from basic reforms to a clear call for autonomous self-government (Swaraj) within the British Empire, explicitly modeled on the self-governing colonies of Canada and Australia.

qe: The Indian Councils Act of 1892 raised the number of additional non-official members in the Imperial Legislative Council to which standard parameters?
qh: भारतीय परिषद अधिनियम 1892 ने इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल में अतिरिक्त गैर-आधिकारिक सदस्यों (non-official members) की संख्या को बढ़ाकर कितना कर दिया था?
o: Ten to sixteen non-officials (instead of six to ten previously)
Twenty-four to fifty non-officials (instead of twelve to twenty previously)
Six to twelve non-officials instead of none previously
Exactly seventy-two non-officials to represent all major towns
e: Detailed Explanation: The Indian Councils Act of 1892 increased the size of the legislatures. In the Imperial Legislative Council, the number of additional non-official members was raised to a minimum of ten and a maximum of sixteen (up from the previous six to ten range).

qe: The Indian Councils Act of 1892 introduced the principle of indirect representation. Who among the following entities was authorized to recommend non-official members for the legislative councils?
qh: भारतीय परिषद अधिनियम 1892 ने अप्रत्यक्ष प्रतिनिधित्व का सिद्धांत पेश किया। निम्नलिखित में से किस संस्था को विधान परिषदों के लिए गैर-आधिकारिक सदस्यों की सिफारिश करने का अधिकार दिया गया था?
o: Universities, municipalities, zamindars, and chambers of commerce
The executive committee of the All India Kisan Sabha exclusively
The core missionary councils based in London and New York City
The direct legal body of all low-caste village panchayat heads
e: Detailed Explanation: Under the 1892 Act, non-official members could be recommended by local bodies such as universities, municipal boards, district zamindars, and regional chambers of commerce, introducing the initial structural principle of representation.

qe: What major structural limitation rendered the 'reformed' Imperial Legislative Council under the Act of 1892 largely ineffective till its next update in 1909?
qh: 1892 के अधिनियम के तहत 'सुधारित' इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल को 1909 में इसके अगले अपडेट तक मुख्य रूप से किस बड़ी संरचनात्मक सीमा ने अप्रभावी बना दिया था?
o: The official members retained their absolute majority, the budget could not be voted upon, and no amendments could be made to it
The non-official Indian members held an absolute two-thirds veto power over executive laws
It was completely barred from discussing any civil administration issues
The Council was legally forced to meet for only three days in a century
e: Detailed Explanation: The Indian Councils Act of 1892 kept key restrictions in place. Official members retained their clear majority, members were barred from voting on the budget or moving amendments, and asking supplementary questions was strictly forbidden.

qe: Between its tenure from 1892 to 1909, how many days on average did the 'reformed' Imperial Legislative Council meet in a single year?
qh: 1892 से 1909 तक अपने कार्यकाल के बीच, 'सुधारित' इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल की बैठक एक वर्ष में औसतन कितने दिन हुई थी?
o: An average of only thirteen days in a year
Exactly forty-five days in a year
More than a hundred days in a year
Strictly six days in a year concurrent with autumn cycles
e: Detailed Explanation: Statistics illustrate the limited impact of the 1892 reforms. Till 1909, the council met for an average of only thirteen days per year, and the active presence of unofficial Indian members was limited to just five out of twenty-four total members.

qe: What moral ground did the Moderate nationalists raise when campaigning for the comprehensive Indianization of the higher administrative government services?
qh: उच्च प्रशासनिक सरकारी सेवाओं के व्यापक भारतीयकरण (Indianization) के लिए अभियान चलाते समय नरमपंथी राष्ट्रवादियों ने कौन सा नैतिक आधार उठाया था?
o: That Indians were being heavily discriminated against by being kept away from positions of trust and responsibility within their own country
That British civil servants completely lacked any knowledge of English legal primaries
That foreign bureaucrats completely refused to consume food cooked by upper castes
That the civil service exam required candidates to hold technical degrees from Sanskrit colleges
e: Detailed Explanation: The demand for Indianization of services was based on three pillars: economic (reducing high salaries), political (curbing economic drain), and moral—objecting to the systemic racial discrimination that excluded qualified Indians from positions of trust and administrative responsibility.

qe: The early nationalists fiercely criticized the aggressive foreign policy executed by the colonial government. Which military campaigns did they oppose due to the heavy financial burden they placed on the Indian treasury?
qh: शुरुआती राष्ट्रवादियों ने औपनिवेशिक सरकार द्वारा अपनाई गई आक्रामक विदेश नीति की तीखी आलोचना की। भारतीय खजाने पर भारी वित्तीय बोझ डालने के कारण उन्होंने किन सैन्य अभियानों का विरोध किया?
o: The annexation of Burma, attacks on Afghanistan, and suppression of tribals in the North-West
The deployment of marine shipping routes to trade with South American states
The structural cross-border migrations entering French Pondicherry borders
The setting up of high-cost meteorological observatories inside polar biomes
e: Detailed Explanation: The Congress resolutions consistently condemned the colonial government's aggressive imperial foreign policy. They strongly opposed the annexation of Burma, military invasions of Afghanistan, and tribal suppression in the North-West, which diverted scarce Indian tax revenues away from public welfare.

qe: What programmatic limitation characterizes the democratic base of the Moderate nationalist movement between 1885 and 1905?
qh: 1885 और 1905 के बीच नरमपंथी राष्ट्रवादी आंदोलन के लोकतांत्रिक आधार (democratic base) की कौन सी कार्यक्रम संबंधी सीमा विशेषता थी?
o: They failed to widen the democratic base of the movement by not including the masses, especially women, and not demanding universal voting rights
They strictly restricted their membership parameters to wealthy Parsi corporate managers exclusively
They completely refused to publish any journals or print materials in vernacular languages
They aligned their platform entirely with the conservative orthodox groups of the Dharma Sabha
e: Detailed Explanation: A key limitation of the Moderates was their narrow social base. Their movement was largely confined to the educated, urban middle-class professional elite and failed to integrate the common masses, peasants, or women, and they did not demand universal adult franchise at that stage.

qe: The protection and defense of civil rights—including the right to free speech, thought, and a free press—became an integral part of the national struggle following public outrage over which historical event in 1897?
qh: मुक्त भाषण, विचार और स्वतंत्र प्रेस के अधिकार सहित नागरिक अधिकारों की सुरक्षा और रक्षा, 1897 में किस ऐतिहासिक घटना पर जनता के भारी आक्रोश के बाद राष्ट्रीय संघर्ष का एक अभिन्न हिस्सा बन गई?
o: The arrest of Lokmanya Tilak and several other journalists alongside the deportation of the Natu brothers without a trial
The permanent seizure of James Augustus Hickey's printing press equipment by a magistrate's order
The legal passage of the Child Marriage Restraint Act raising the marriageable age parameters
The administrative shutdown of the newly established Central Hindu College at Benaras
e: Detailed Explanation: In 1897, public anger erupted across India following the arrest and imprisonment of Bal Gangadhar Tilak and other journalists on sedition charges, alongside the arbitrary arrest and deportation of the Natu brothers without any legal trial, making the defense of civil liberties a core pillar of the freedom struggle.

qe: A tracking route charts a right-angled triangular configuration. A survey vehicle drives 48 km South from station O, and then changes course to move 14 km West to reach research point R. Calculate the direct straight-line distance from O to R.
qh: एक कार स्टेशन O से 48 किमी दक्षिण की ओर चलती है, और फिर दिशा बदलकर पश्चिम की ओर 14 किमी जाकर बिंदु R पर पहुँचती है। O से R की सीधी रेखा की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
o: 50 km
62 km
54 km
52 km
e:
Detailed Explanation: The movement forms a right-angled triangle with perpendicular legs of 48 km and 14 km. The hypotenuse represents the direct straight-line distance.
Applying the Pythagoras theorem: $\text{Distance} = \sqrt{48^2 + 14^2} = \sqrt{2304 + 196} = \sqrt{2500} = \mathbf{50\text{ km}}$.

qe: In an ecosystem productivity tracking survey mapping energy parameters, if the measured Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) is 54,000 units and the energy accumulated as Net Primary Productivity (NPP) is 34,000 units, calculate the energy spent during metabolic respiration (R).
qh: ऊर्जा मापदंडों का मानचित्रण करने वाले एक पारिस्थितिकी उत्पादकता सर्वेक्षण में, यदि मापी गई सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (GPP) 54,000 इकाइयाँ है और शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (NPP) के रूप में संचित ऊर्जा 34,000 इकाइयाँ है, तो श्वसन (R) के दौरान खर्च की गई ऊर्जा की गणना करें।
o: 20,000 units
88,000 units
40,000 units
16,000 units
e:
Detailed Explanation: Utilizing the core ecological relationship formula: $NPP = GPP - R$, we rewrite it to isolate respiration losses: $R = GPP - NPP$.
Substituting the given numbers: $R = 54,000 - 34,000 = \mathbf{20,000\text{ units}}$.

qe: Political associations in the first half of the nineteenth century differed structurally from those formed in the second half. What element dominated these early associations?
qh: उन्नीसवीं शताब्दी के पूर्वार्ध (first half) के राजनीतिक संगठन उत्तरार्ध में बने संगठनों से संरचनात्मक रूप से भिन्न थे। इन शुरुआती संगठनों में किस तत्व का दबदबा था?
o: Wealthy and aristocratic elements who were local or regional in character
The newly educated middle class comprising lawyers, doctors, and teachers exclusively
Unorganized landless agricultural ryots from backward subdivisions
Industrial working-class labor fronts managed by trade unions
e: Detailed Explanation: Most political associations in the first half of the 19th century (like the Landholders' Society) were dominated by wealthy and aristocratic elements. They were local or regional in character and focused primarily on sending long petitions to the British Parliament for specific administrative reforms.

qe: What was the characteristic feature of the political associations that emerged in the second half of the nineteenth century in British India?
qh: ब्रिटिश भारत में उन्नीसवीं शताब्दी के उत्तरार्ध (second half) में उभरे राजनीतिक संगठनों की विशेषता क्या थी?
o: They were increasingly dominated by the educated middle class—lawyers, journalists, doctors, and teachers—with a wider perspective and larger agenda
They were secret religious revivalist fronts focused entirely on launching armed mutinies
They restricted their institutional participation exclusively to loyalist princely elites
They rejected any political propaganda or educational campaigns across rural areas
e: Detailed Explanation: The political associations of the second half of the 19th century (such as the Indian Association of Calcutta and the Poona Sarvajanik Sabha) saw a leadership shift. They were increasingly dominated by the educated middle class—lawyers, journalists, doctors, and teachers—who brought a wider national perspective and a larger reform agenda.

qe: The British Indian Association, formed in 1851 by the merger of older groups, submitted a long petition to the British Parliament demanding specific fiscal reforms. Which tax relief did they demand?
qh: 1851 में पुराने समूहों के विलय से बने ब्रिटिश इंडियन एसोसिएशन ने ब्रिटिश संसद को एक लंबी याचिका भेजी थी। उन्होंने किस विशिष्ट कर राहत (tax relief) की मांग की थी?
o: Abolition of salt duty, abkari (excise) duty, and stamp duties
Imposition of an entry transit tax on all British machine-made textile shipments
The absolute elimination of all land revenue collections across Bengal permanently
Levying a high progressive income tax on poor subsistence cultivators
e: Detailed Explanation: The British Indian Association's 1851 petition demanded several critical financial reliefs for the sub-continent, prominently the absolute abolition of the salt duty, abkari (excise taxes on intoxicants), and stamp duties.

qe: Which pre-Congress organization is recognized as the most important forerunner of the Indian National Congress, even sponsoring an All India Conference in 1883 before formally merging with the Congress in 1886?
qh: 1886 में कांग्रेस में औपचारिक रूप से विलय होने से पहले 1883 में एक अखिल भारतीय सम्मेलन को प्रायोजित करने वाले संगठन को भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण अग्रदूत माना जाता है?
o: The Indian Association of Calcutta
The British Indian Association
The Indian League
The Poona Sarvajanik Sabha
e: Detailed Explanation: The Indian Association of Calcutta (founded in 1876 by Banerjea and Bose) was the most important of the pre-Congress nationalist associations. It organized the first All India National Conference in 1883 and formally merged with the Indian National Congress in 1886.

qe: The early Moderate nationalists utilized a distinct political strategy to put forward public demands before the colonial state. Critics and neo-nationalists later mockingly referred to this strategy as the method of:
qh: शुरुआती नरमपंथी राष्ट्रवादियों ने औपनिवेशिक राज्य के सामने सार्वजनिक मांगें रखने के लिए एक अलग राजनीतिक रणनीति का इस्तेमाल किया। आलोचकों और नव-राष्ट्रवादियों ने बाद में इस रणनीति को मज़ाक में किसकी पद्धति कहा?
o: Prayer and petition through constitutional agitation
Armed guerrilla warfare and secret structural boycotts
Spontaneous mass baseline non-cooperation strikes
Universal adult franchise tracking and civil disobedience
e: Detailed Explanation: The Moderates relied on constitutional methods and legal agitation within the confines of law. They utilized a careful methodology of passing resolutions, organizing meetings, and sending petitions ('prayer and petition'), resorting to constitutional agitation if initial appeals failed.

qe: The 'Indian National Conference', which held two successful pan-Indian sessions in 1883 and 1885 with representatives from all major towns of India, had which two leaders as its main architects?
qh: 1883 और 1885 में भारत के सभी प्रमुख शहरों के प्रतिनिधियों के साथ दो सफल अखिल भारतीय सत्र आयोजित करने वाले 'इंडियन नेशनल कॉन्फ्रेंस' (Indian National Conference) के मुख्य वास्तुकार कौन दो नेता थे?
o: Surendranath Banerjea and Ananda Mohan Bose
Dadabhai Naoroji and Dinshaw Wacha
Badruddin Tyabji and Pherozshah Mehta
W.C. Bonnerjee and A.O. Hume
e: Detailed Explanation: The Indian National Conference, which held multi-regional sessions in 1883 and 1885 as a prelude to the Congress, had Surendranath Banerjea and Ananda Mohan Bose as its main architects and structural organizers.

qe: In the history of the Indian National Congress, who holds the distinction of being elected thrice as the President of its annual national sessions during the early phase?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के इतिहास में, प्रारंभिक चरण के दौरान इसके वार्षिक राष्ट्रीय सत्रों के अध्यक्ष के रूप में तीन बार चुने जाने का गौरव किसे प्राप्त है?
o: Dadabhai Naoroji
W.C. Bonnerjee
Badruddin Tyabji
Surendranath Banerjea
e: Detailed Explanation: Dadabhai Naoroji, the 'Grand Old Man of India' and a prominent Moderate economic analyst, holds the historic distinction of presiding over the annual sessions of the Indian National Congress three times during its early phase.

qe: A major programmatic aim of the Indian National Congress in its initial stage was focused on political workers from different regions. What was this objective?
qh: अपने प्रारंभिक चरण में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का एक प्रमुख कार्यक्रम संबंधी उद्देश्य विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के राजनीतिक कार्यकर्ताओं पर केंद्रित था। यह उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: To promote friendly relations among nationalist political workers from different parts of the country
To legally force all local workers to exclusively adopt English-medium speech models
To systematically train workers to initiate armed industrial factory strikes in Bombay
To restrict political activity tracking parameters strictly to the city of Calcutta
e: Detailed Explanation: One of the core organizational aims of the early Congress was to establish a national center for the movement and to promote friendly, cooperative relations among nationalist political workers traveling from different parts of the country.

qe: How did Moderate leaders like Pherozshah Mehta and Gopal Krishna Gokhale utilize the Imperial Legislative Council before 1892 despite its complete lack of real official power?
qh: फिरोजशाह मेहता और गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले जैसे नरमपंथी नेताओं ने 1892 से पहले इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल का उपयोग कैसे किया, जबकि इसके पास वास्तविक आधिकारिक शक्ति की कमी थी?
o: They transformed the councils into active forums for ventilating popular grievances, exposing bureaucratic defects, and raising basic economic issues
They used the council rooms to stage violent, armed non-cooperation agitations against the Viceroy
They systematically endorsed every restrictive government proposal without any critical scrutiny
They completely boycotted the council sessions and refused to accept any nominations from the Crown
e: Detailed Explanation: Although the pre-1892 legislative council was a powerless body, brilliant Moderate intellectuals like Pherozshah Mehta and G.K. Gokhale used it effectively as a public forum to voice grievances, criticize financial spending, expose the indifferent bureaucracy, and build anti-imperialist sentiment.
